<p class="eyebrow">A little about me</p>
<h2>Building the skills to make data make sense.</h2>
<div class="about-copy">
<p class="about-lede">I’m a Computer Science student at the University of Nebraska–Lincoln, interested in the space where data science, AI, and communication meet.</p>
<p>I enjoy organizing information, exploring patterns, and turning findings into something clear and useful. I’m continuing to grow my technical toolkit while building a thoughtful, practical approach to analytical work.</p>

<div class="approach-section">
<div class="section-heading">
  <p class="eyebrow">My approach</p>
  <h2>Thoughtful at every step.</h2>
</div>
<ol class="approach-list">
  <li><span>Start with the question</span><p>Understand what the analysis should help someone learn or decide.</p></li>
  <li><span>Keep the process clear</span><p>Make data preparation and analytical steps organized and repeatable.</p></li>
  <li><span>Explain the result</span><p>Share limitations and findings in language that makes sense to the audience.</p></li>
